name: calmfox/watch-neos
description: Neos CMS integration for Calmfox Watch (https://watch.calmfox.net), a website monitoring service that scores site health from 0 to 100 (availability, security, updates, content, performance). Adds a secret health endpoint with service status (database, disk, mail, cache, resource publishing, content repository), basic security hygiene checks and a package version history.

suggest.flowpack/jobqueue-common: Enables the job queue check (queue). Without this package the check is skipped entirely.
suggest.flowpack/elasticsearch-contentrepository: Enables the search cluster check (elasticsearch). Without this package the check is skipped entirely.
